verdict.rationale: Raygun ships an 'AI Resolution' feature that lets users chat with an AI to auto-prompt an LLM with stack trace/error context and get root-cause fix suggestions, plus collaborative chat and commenting on the AI conversation (raygun-docs-4, raygun-docs-5, raygun-docs-27, raygun-docs-30). However this delegation is scoped narrowly to crash-error triage/fixing rather than general task delegation, and requires the user to supply their own OpenAI API key rather than a fully built-in assistant (raygun-docs-32). Missing for 10: evidence of broader task delegation beyond error resolution, and a truly zero-setup built-in assistant without needing an external API key.
